name: Exmouth Rugby Club
summary: A clubhouse with its own bar, kitchen and patio for the barbecue.
description: The clubhouse at Exmouth Rugby Club is a proper community venue: a main hall with its own bar, a members' lounge, a working kitchen, and an outdoor patio with picnic tables for a barbecue. It is used for a real mix of occasions — christenings, wedding receptions, wakes, big birthday parties — and being a members' club, rates tend to be friendlier than a hotel or restaurant.
